verdict.rationale: E2B's own docs say outbound internet access can be controlled with an on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists, which is an explicit egress policy. A second doc page separately mentions 'outbound network controls'. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the policy rule syntax and granularity (domains, IPs, CIDRs, ports) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the allow/deny enforcement works as claimed.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy

citations.quote: Control and restrict it with a simple on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists.
pause/resume persistence, and outbound network controls
